title: Genie One enhancements
body:
* **Genie Code skills in Genie One (Beta)**: Genie Code skills now appear and are turned on by default in Genie One. Turn individual skills on or off on the customization page.
* **Backend steering**: You can now send steering messages to Genie One while it's answering, so you can guide a response without waiting for it to finish.
* **PowerPoint uploads**: You can now upload PowerPoint (`.pptx`) files to a Genie One conversation. See [Upload a file](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#upload-a-file).
* **Memory confirmation prompts (Beta)**: Genie One can now suggest a memory when it detects a fact worth remembering in your request and asks you to confirm before saving it. Approve, modify, or reject the suggestion. See [Add to Genie One's memory](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#memory).
